<!-- pr-reviewer: c74d888d9049f4a1c97aad8eee29f15a57d79895 -->
**Verdict: clean delta, merges after #1615.** No blockers found in what #1622 adds.

**Scope.** This review covers only `git diff 4f05e9c0..c74d888d` (11 commits, one merge: 3b532fac, whose `--remerge-diff` touches only `generate.rs`, 5 lines added and 20 removed, and is consistent with the two sides' intent). #1615's own code is not re-reviewed here, and NeoTech's needs-rework on #1615 stands and is NeoTech's to clear. #1622's base `main` includes #1615's commits, so **#1622 cannot merge before #1615 does**; merging it alone would carry #1615 in.

**What looks good**
- Stock-source Engrave and Trace now take the mark law against the setup's parts (`generate.rs` `parts_marked`, both the flat and the plane-frame arm), so #1615's floor and the unlowered shank check apply. The 2 mm plate is pinned in `mark_floor.rs::a_stock_source_cut_through_the_plate_meets_the_same_floor`, on both stocks, through-cut and 0.1 mm-web, and the legal 0.3 mm mark still posts.
- #1621: `keep_law::neighbour_parts` runs the plain solid law (`DepthLaw::Keep`, no mark budget) against every other setup part, in both arms. It is empty for a stock source, for a one-part document, and for kinds with no part law. A healthy one-part file therefore takes no new path. The existing posting, lead_approach and machine_switch suites pass unchanged.
- `budget_of` now declares the mark for a stock source, so the op and the program sim agree.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added in `crates/app/src`. No process files, `Cargo.toml` or `build.rs` touched. The delta adds no `crates/sim/src` change.
- Body has `Fixes #1607`, `Fixes #1621` and a `Changelog:` line.

**Results** (locally, merged state is the PR head; main was not trial-merged because the PR reports MERGEABLE and the runner API returned 403, so no runner was used)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib`: 252 passed, 1 ignored.
- App suites, each passing: stock_source_law 6, neighbour_law 5, mark_floor 5, engrave_law 9, area_controls 13, stock_source_verdict 22, keep_law 7, posting 17, stock_sim_document 9, circular_entity_law 4, circular_pick_law 4, slot_picks 8, trochoid_law 6, post_not_judged 4, lead_approach 6, machine_switch 6. Sim mark_credit: 9 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: the full quick-gate plan (it maps to nearly every sim/app/ui suite because of the base), the ui suites, Windows arms.

**Mutations re-run by me (all go red, tree restored after each)**
1. Neighbour law off in both arms: neighbour_law 2 fail (`a_cut_on_b_into_its_neighbour_gouges_on_the_op_and_never_posts`, the MCP twin) and area_controls 1 fail.
2. `parts_marked = false` (stock-source mark law off): mark_floor 1, engrave_law 1 and stock_source_law 3 fail.
3. `parts_in_stock` narrowed back to the pocket family: stock_source_law 4 fail.

**Changed existing tests: read as real behaviour changes, not weakened guards**
- `area_controls`: the tower beside the tilted pocket is now a neighbour the +3 offset really enters, so the frame-door comparison moves to a tower-free scene, and a new assert (`w_tower > 0`) pins that the tower is judged. The guard got stronger.
- `stock_source_verdict`: marking the casting stock-only now needs a regenerate, because the op's stamp does not follow the neighbour set. This is the filed #1628. It only makes the cached verdict stricter until regenerated (safe direction), but the tests now encode that gap; see note 1.
- Also moved: `engrave_law` (stock-source cut is now judged, asserts flipped from 0 gouges to more than 0), `posting` (the fixture now generates a gouge on the op, and the sim still leads the refusal).

**Requested before merge**
None for this delta.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. #1628 (P1, filed): the op's stamp does not digest the other parts, so a part moved or added into a part-source or stock-source op's cut after generation leaves that op Ok. The sim still judges an aligned stock, but on a turned stock the sim does not judge and the post is not refused. The author states this is not a regression (those parts were not judged at all before), and the stamp term was built, pinned and taken back out because it conflicts with five existing "workholding never stales" tests. This is the maintainer's call, but note a P1 stays open behind a "Fixes" PR.
2. Behaviour change confirmed: a whole-model pocket on B that cuts through A is now refused on the op. This is the intent of #1621.
3. `generate.rs` is 3548 lines and `job.rs` 461 lines (already over ~400; the delta adds about 50 lines to generate.rs). Pre-existing growth, not blocking. The new files are under 400.
4. `keep_law.rs::kept_models` has an unreachable `!part_solid` arm (its only caller returns early), so it could be simplified.
5. The sim's mark credit still credits a neighbouring part the budget, and the op is the stricter judge (#1627).

**Label.** No state label set: the delta is clean, but the PR is stacked on #1615, which carries a standing needs-rework, so `merge-ready` would be misleading until #1615 clears.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c74d888d9049f4a1c97aad8eee29f15a57d79895 -->
**Verdict: no blockers in the delta; waits for #1615.** Read only the commits after 4f05e9c0 (`git diff 4f05e9c0..c74d888d`). Built and tested on the self-hosted runner (Results below).

**#1615's open finding (`crates/sim/src/verify/solid.rs:191-195`).** This head does not change it and does not fix it: `solid.rs` is untouched after 4f05e9c0 (the straight up-rapid that starts where a cutting move ended is still skipped when `stack_only && axis.is_none()`). It is carried, not new. Note the exposure grows: a stock-source Engrave/Trace now runs the mark law too, so an overhang above the end of an open stock-source engraving line is subject to the same skip. It is #1615's to clear; this PR cannot merge before it, and merging it alone would carry #1615 in.

**What I checked by reading (trying to break it)**
- `is_stock_kept_kind` covers every 2D kind that has a part law on a part source (pocket family, Slot, Trochoidal slot, Circular, Contour, Face, Engrave, Trace). Left out on purpose and documented: 2D Chamfer, Drill/Bore/Thread (a stock-source cut of those into a held part still posts with no op finding; the program sim judges an aligned stock only). Not a regression, but a remaining hole for turned stock; a follow-up issue would be wise.
- Both `run_job` arms (flat and 3+2 frame) route `parts_marked` / `keep_parts` / `neighbour_parts` the same way; the solid law is skipped for marks only (`!parts_marked`), so no kind gets neither law. A setup with no part gives empty sets: nothing judged, as before.
- `budget_of` no longer needs `names_part`; the sim credit and the op's mesh are the same set (`parts_facets_in`).
- `neighbour_parts` reads `depth_law_of(..., true)`, which does not know `around_part`: with no stock in the setup a whole-model pocket still judges the other parts. Reasonable, not a defect.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added in `crates/app/src`.

**Results** (on the self-hosted runner, a macOS machine: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43558176674; PR head trial-merged with main c00ba18a)
- Quick gate on the merged tree: sim suites ok, motion suites ok, app suites ok, ui suites ok; 4 steps, 0 failed (wall 18.9 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: Windows arms (I found no cfg(windows) or per-OS pinned value in the delta), and I did not re-run the author's mutations.

**Requested before merge (delta):** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. #1628 (P1, filed): the op's stamp does not follow the parts beside its source, so a part moved into the cut after generation still posts on a turned stock. Author states it is not a regression and keeps it open; a P1 stays open behind a PR whose body has `Fixes` for others. Maintainer's call.
2. The sim still credits a neighbour part the mark budget (#1627); the op is the stricter judge.
3. `generate.rs` (about 3.5k lines) and `job.rs` are far over ~400 lines; pre-existing growth.
4. `keep_law.rs::kept_models`: the `!part_solid` arm is unreachable from its only caller.

**Label.** None set: stacked on #1615, which carries a standing needs-rework.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
